text: Associated with the lack of an existing product is the inability of most crypto platforms to generate revenue to offset costs the way traditional businesses do, since they typically have neither employees who create and advertise a product nor customers who generate revenue.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Marco Dell'Erba, Initial Coin Offerings Emerging Practices, Risk Factors, and Red Flags (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3067615
